## Hosted CI defect At [PR #64](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/pull/64) head `1873ac06cf97a98e224d0e8fabd024f05c652eb6`, the four test/release jobs in run 42163459633 fail at the generated changelog check. The head, discussion and latest checks were rechecked on 2026-11-06; no newer successful run supersedes these failures. The inspected checkout is synthetic merge `85e475a700e3c430de48cf7503934005a559184d`, merging that candidate into base `0b3d5a38611ae00dd375393d7f9133249783ebf9`. Package version is `2026.11.5`; the declared pm-changelog pin is `2026.10.31`. PR #64 changes only the CodeQL workflow. This report does not attribute the failure to that action update. ## Evidence and exact failure Full official logs inspected: - [Node 26](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/actions/runs/42163459633/job/127714311203) - [npm release gate](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/actions/runs/42163459633/job/127714311246) - [Bun release gate](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/actions/runs/42163459633/job/127714311252) Each reaches `changelog:check` after passing coverage, production audit and package packing. Coverage reports 1,095/1,095 tests passing, zero failures, and 2,351/2,351 independently measured statements at the unchanged 100% statement gate. Production audits report zero vulnerabilities. All three then exit 1 with this same committed-versus-generated difference: ```diff # Changelog +## Unreleased + +No changes. + ## 2026.11.5 - 2026-11-05 No changes. ``` [Node 22 step results](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/actions/runs/42163459633/job/127714310878) independently confirm successful coverage/audit/packing followed by changelog failure; its full log was not separately inspected. The [committed changelog](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/blob/1873ac06cf97a98e224d0e8fabd024f05c652eb6/CHANGELOG.md#L1-L7) begins with the dated release. The [package scripts](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/blob/1873ac06cf97a98e224d0e8fabd024f05c652eb6/package.json#L39-L45) use replacement/all-release-tags/include-empty generation for both `changelog:full` and `changelog:check`, with `--check` added for validation. ## Expected, impact and limits The established [canonical changelog goal](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/blob/0b3d5a38611ae00dd375393d7f9133249783ebf9/.agents/pm/issues/pm-ado-r5ps.toon) and [PR #74](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/pull/74) require generation and checking to agree while preserving truthful empty dated releases. On the observed source and fetched-tag context, validation instead requires an additional empty pending section. This blocks the complete CI/release gate. This is a hosted artifact-consistency finding, not a locally reproduced generator root cause or an Azure/native-backend runtime regression. No new tests, installs, provider calls, reruns, merges or releases were performed for this review. Changes in tag context versus generation-time state remain to be isolated rather than assumed. Later publish-attestation, release-date and native-precondition checks were skipped or not reached after the failure. Passing the preceding tests does not certify the full release gate or native-precondition conformance. ## Acceptance and regression criteria - Reconcile generated and committed changelog semantics so the standard check passes deterministically for the same source and explicit release/tag context, without an unexplained empty-heading diff. - Add a focused regression covering a prepared empty dated release and subsequent post-tag validation, plus a genuine pending change. Preserve truthful dated `No changes.` sections and real unreleased entries. - Keep generation centralized in the existing package scripts. Do not bypass the check, suppress meaningful changes or weaken coverage/release gates. - Rerun Node 22/26 and npm/Bun gates on one immutable corrected head, showing the changelog check and previously unreached later stages separately. ## Deduplication Checked all 89 all-status ADO issue/PR records, current PR #64 discussion, related #71/#74/#89 discussions and all 51 canonical records at the current default (each verified against its Git blob hash). No exact owner for this failure was found. Closed `pm-ado-r5ps`/#74 addressed an earlier duplicated-workflow-flags mismatch; [pm-changelog #47](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/issues/47) describes older stale/duplicated Unreleased behavior. Neither establishes that this distinct current ADO failure is already tracked. --- ### GitHub comments (1) > **@coderabbitai[bot]** (2026-11-06T05:37:58Z) > > > > >
